query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_molecules,
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN cas_number IS NULL OR cas_number = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS UNSIGNED) as sans_cas,
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN cas_number IS NOT NULL AND cas_number != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS UNSIGNED) as avec_cas
FROM molecules;
